notes: Full descriptor-screening chain: implement a recursive formula parser (nesting, hydrate multipliers via U+00B7 and ASCII dot, leading part multipliers), a descriptor lookup+arithmetic stage (molar mass from a JSON mass table), tolerance filtering with a rounding-defined inclusive boundary, normalized proximity scoring (dnorm/score with a tolerance==0 special case), deterministic ranking (distance then id tie-break), plus a counts/echo report, and deliver the program + artifacts produced by running it on the visible fixtures. Hidden cases vary mass tables, cover nested/hydrate formulas, unknown elements, unbalanced parens, lowercase starts, whitespace, bare multipliers, missing/non-string formulas, a non-JSON line, an exact-hit d=0 row, an exact inclusive-boundary row, a distance tie, and an empty dataset. Rubric nonzero for dependent_stages (parser -> descriptor -> filter -> rank -> report -> artifacts), reasoning_depth (recursive grammar + rounding contract), debugging_ambiguity (boundary/tie semantics), adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden cases), quantitative_correctness (exact floats, sort order, counts). No tool breadth, resource pressure, or statefulness; totals bucket to hard.
